record: PSSolver RC4.1.0 Plane free-slip Nyquist/storage diagnostic

causal_adjudication.trigger: The periodic axis not used as the Hermitian-half reduction axis has an even spatial extent and carries Nyquist content.
causal_adjudication.axis_rotation_control: Changing hermitian_axis from 1 to 0 changes the triggering non-reduced axis from x to y.
causal_adjudication.input_filter_control: Removing only the triggering non-reduced-axis Nyquist input plane restores full-complex versus Hermitian-half physical-field agreement to below 1e-12.
causal_adjudication.odd_grid_control: Odd periodic extents agree to below 1e-12 without filtering.
causal_adjudication.residual_blind_spot: Both storage paths satisfy their native modal saddle residuals near roundoff even when their physical outputs disagree, so native residual tests alone cannot detect B5.
causal_adjudication.scope_limit: This record localizes the storage-equivalence trigger. It does not claim that filtering only the non-reduced axis is the production repair; the qualified repair must apply the common real-grid Nyquist convention to both periodic axes.

next_stage.name: RC4.1.1 Plane Nyquist repair
required_behavior: zero the real-grid first-derivative Nyquist multiplier on every even periodic axis
project the affected force and solution modes consistently with the Periodic and Channel Stokes conventions
make full-complex and Hermitian-half storage equivalent on even grids
